sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Sheshadri Trivedi,Ajay Kumar Pandey,Satish Trivedi (Senior Adv.
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard Sri Satish Trivedi, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Sri Ajay Kr. Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant Arvind Kumar Prasad with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.114 of 2021, u/s 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., P.S.
Gagaha, District Gorakhpur, during pendency of the trial.
It is alleged in the FIR that the applicant got appointment on the post of Assistant Teacher on account of forged and fabricated documents.
It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Applicant is terminated from his service.

It is further submitted that the applicant had not impersonated while getting appointment and the documents Arvind Kumar Prasad vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29119588/
1 supplied by him were genuine.

entities.text: Arvind Kumar Prasad vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to heavy dockets.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 3.1.2022 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant but could not dispute the aforesaid fact.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and larger mandate of the Article 21 of the Constitution of India, Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Arvind Kumar Prasad, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
